claims.statement: Tom Allen, Charley Daly and John Ryan were tried in Police Court on counter charges of disturbing the peace over the Sunday-morning street fight.
claims.excerpt: Tom Alien, Charley Daly and Jobn Ryan being up on counter charges of disturbing the peace

claims.statement: Judge Cady fined Tom Allen $10 for disturbing the peace.
claims.excerpt: the testimony was very mixed and he would fine the defendants $10 each.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said Bob Farrell tripped him while Dan Daly and a crowd kicked him while he was down.
claims.excerpt: the ex-cbampion said Bob Farreil tripped him while Dan Daly and a whole crowd kicked him while he was down.
places: Seventh and Market streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen had a cut and discolored ear and a bruise on the side of his face after the street fight.
claims.excerpt: a cut and discolored ear and a bruise on the side of the face.

claims.statement: The Police Court report calls Tom Allen the ex-champion of the world.
claims.excerpt: Charley came out to pacify the ex-champion ofthe world.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: They "ad Ry putty lively foot-ball match wid me for awhile
quotes.topic: his account of being tripped and kicked
